paragraphs: Rav Mesharshia son of Rav Idi.
He is mentioned in Gittin 30b following the words of Abaye, and in Avodah Zarah 13a he resolves the words of Resh Lakish.[^1]

notes.text: ר״ל is read contextually as Resh Lakish, without adding Rabbi. ל: and יג. give Gittin 30b and Avodah Zarah 13a under the colon/period convention, without independently checked named editions. After-Abaye describes textual placement, not a proven personal meeting or later generation. Both heading Rav titles are full.
